services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Tripped electrics, blown fuses, or a complete loss of power? We're on call 24/7 and aim to be with you in under an hour, any time of day or night.

services.title: Rewires & Upgrades
services.desc: Old or unsafe wiring? We carry out full rewires to modern standards, including new consumer units and earthing upgrades. Work completed to building regulations.

services.title: Socket & Switch Installation
services.desc: Need extra sockets, USB outlets, or smart switches? We install them quickly and safely, with all work tested and certified.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Installation
services.desc: Experienced in electric boiler and heating system installation. We handle disconnection, new pipework, and full commissioning.

services.title: Fault Finding & Repair
services.desc: Flickering lights, buzzing panels, or intermittent power loss? We diagnose the cause and fix it properly, not just the symptom.

services.title: Electrical Testing & Certification
services.desc: EICR testing and periodic inspections for landlords, property sales, and insurance claims. Full certified report provided.

about_pullquote: I started this business to show Southampton there's an electrician who actually turns up on time.
about_para_1: TG Electrical has been serving Southampton homes and businesses for over 15 years. What started as a single-handed operation has grown into a trusted local name, built on one simple idea: arrive fast, do the job right, and charge fairly. We're NICEIC registered and fully insured, with thousands of jobs completed across the city and beyond.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we answer the phone, we show up when we say we will, and we explain what's wrong before we start work. We don't believe in surprise invoices or cutting corners. Whether it's a midnight emergency or a planned rewire, you get the same standard of work and the same straightforward approach.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Nightmare with a tripped fuse box on a Sunday. Called TG Electrical expecting to wait days. Guy arrived in 45 minutes, diagnosed a faulty socket, and had us back to normal before lunch. Professional, friendly, and the bill was fair. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had the whole house rewired. Was worried about cost and disruption, but they worked efficiently, kept the mess to a minimum, and finished bang on schedule. All certified and guaranteed. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Lisa P.

reviews.text: Called for an emergency — electric shower completely dead. TG Electrical arrived within the hour, found the problem was the RCD switch, replaced it, and tested everything. No faffing about, no overcharging. Great service.
reviews.author: David M.
